issues.title: [EPIC] Voice sweep fixes — 15-post Dark Crystal audit (2026-08-01)
issues.body:
## Epic — Voice audit remediation swarm

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kriskrug-wp` (+ sibling `kk-voice` for VOICE-12)
**Audit SSOT:** `content/drafts/voice-audit-blog-sweep-2026-08-01/00-summary.md` (commit `c93c5b5`)
**Board:** `issues-to-create/voice-audit-blog-sweep-swarm-2026-08-01.md`

## Why this exists

A Dark Crystal voice/slop sweep of 15 live posts (2026-06-18 → 2026-07-31) found: (1) June pipeline assembly failures shipping internal docs and broken markup live, (2) a 26-em-dash blowout on the newest post, (3) a house-tic redefinition-reveal density that dodges the checker. Voice underneath is mostly Kris; remediation is surgical, not a rewrite-everything pass.

## Child issues (waves)

**Wave 1 (parallel, exclusive post IDs):** VOICE-1…VOICE-7  
**Wave 2 (projects / decisions):** VOICE-8…VOICE-11  
**Wave 3 (tooling, kk-voice):** VOICE-12

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All Wave 1 child issues closed or explicitly waived by KK
- [ ] P0 leaks gone from live Canada + What Would Chat Do pages (cache-bypass verified)
- [ ] AI Lands live text has 0 em dashes under `voicecheck.py`
- [ ] Epic comment lists rollback paths for every live apply
- [ ] Wave 2/3 either done or parked with reason

## Tests/Evals

- Re-run mechanical check on touched post snapshots: `~/Code/kk-voice/scripts/voicecheck.py --json <txt>`
- Cache-bypass curls for each mutated URL

## Verification

- Child issue checklists green
- No Track B / theme files in any child PR or live change

## Agent Instructions

- Do not implement fixes in this epic issue. Pick a child.
- Respect exclusive post-ID ownership on the board.

## Out of Scope

- Theme / Aurora / Track B
- Re-auditing the 10 clean/near-clean posts
- Publishing new posts

## Dependencies

- Blocks: none (tracking only)
- Blocked by: none

## Swarm packet — Wave 3 tooling (parallel anytime)

**Repo:** `WalksWithASwagger/kk-voice` (sibling path `~/Code/kk-voice/`) — **not** kriskrug-wp live content  
**Wave:** `swarm-wave-3`  
**Exclusive ownership:** `anti-glossary.md` (+ `scripts/voicecheck.py` only if needed for soft-flag plumbing) + tests/fixtures if the repo has them

## Why this exists

The 2026-08-01 blog sweep found recurring dodges the checker cannot see. Candidates are documented in `kriskrug-wp/content/drafts/voice-audit-blog-sweep-2026-08-01/00-summary.md` (CHECKER-GAP CANDIDATES). Proposal-only in the audit; this issue implements carefully.

## Priority candidates to land

1. **Soft:** decontracted redefinition-reveal `\b(is|are|was) not (just|only|simply) [^.]{3,80}\. (It|That|They|These) (is|are)\b` — flag density, not auto-fail every hit (exemplar cadence matches)
2. **Hard/soft:** umlaut-less `Kris Krug\b` → wrong; canonical Kris Krüg (keep `kriskrug.co` safe)
3. **Hard:** `Eth\?\?s` mojibake
4. **Soft:** `it'?s (\w+ )?not (just|only) ` (intervening word dodge)
5. Optional: inflected `empower(s|ed|ing)?`, `foster(s|ed|ing)?`; soft `teams?`; third-person `Krüg stated` soft flag

## Ownership (exclusive)

- `~/Code/kk-voice/anti-glossary.md`
- Checker behavior only as required for soft vs hard distinction
- Must not edit kriskrug-wp live posts

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Specimens from the sweep (artists-learn L38–40 shape, Eth??s, Kris Krug) fail or soft-flag as designed
- [ ] False-positive notes documented for soft flags (exemplar portrait cadence; satirical quotes)
- [ ] `voicecheck.py` still exits 0 on a known-clean exemplar fixture
- [ ] Changelog / short note in kk-voice README or anti-glossary comment block dated 2026-08-01 sweep
- [ ] PR in kk-voice (not mixed into kriskrug-wp theme PRs)

## Tests/Evals

- Add/adjust fixtures: positive cases for new regexes + negative controls (kriskrug.co URL; intentional irony keep cases noted)
- Run existing voicecheck tests if present

## Verification

```bash
cd ~/Code/kk-voice && scripts/voicecheck.py --json <fixture-with-decontracted-reveal>
# expect soft/hard flag per design
```

## Agent Instructions

- Prefer soft flags where KK cadence is legit.
- Do not enable auto-rewrite.
- Cite sweep summary paths in the PR body.

## Out of Scope

- Live post remediation (Wave 1/2)
- Skill doc path fix for voice-slop-audit (optional drive-by only if trivial and asked)

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: none (may run parallel with Wave 1)
- Parent: voice-sweep EPIC
- Consumes: specimens in kriskrug-wp audit folder (read-only)
